# Majority Element

## Solution

```java
class Solution {
    public int majorityElement(int[] nums) {
        int count = 0, candidate = 0;
        for(int n : nums) {
            if (count == 0) candidate = n;
            count += (n == candidate) ? 1 : -1;
        }
        return candidate;
    }
}
```
